items.title: Larry Page’s flying car company Pivotal loses its CEO
items.feed_excerpt: The company told TechCrunch he is "pursuing new endeavors."

items.title: Reliance’s JioHotstar takes its streaming empire global — without sports
items.feed_excerpt: JioHotstar will only have entertainment content when it launches in the UK, Canada, and Singapore.

items.title: Apple follows Google in adopting Trump’s ‘Lake America’ name
items.feed_excerpt: Apple Maps is following President Trump's executive order to change the name of Lake Ontario to Lake America.
